notes.title: Celebrating 100 years of Polish independence
notes.content:
This year is special for all Poles. Steam wanted to celebrate with us, so they organized a 'Polish Developer Sale" sale for the 100th anniversary of regaining independence by Poland.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29227674/3b103dc38bede2eab5d01bb811185117a2c753c5.jpg[/img]

Therefore, you can purchase many games from Polish developers at promotional prices.

[h1]Offer ends Friday at 10am Pacific Time.[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/654300/Darkest_Hunters/

[h1]Thank you for your support![/h1]

Yours,
Ultimate Games Team

notes.title: Game Update - 2/10/2017
notes.content:
ChangeLog:

- Resolution can be changed in Options
- Full Screen / Windows mode available in Options. ( alt + enter shortcut is enabled)
- 30 FPS Cap removed.
- Fixed achievement „Skin changer”
- Player Stats can be reset only in Town.
- Fixed items prices in blacksmith shop.
- Chests gives more gold now.

notes.title: Darkest Hunter Premiere - 20% discount!
notes.content:

Today is a special day, because our first game - Darkest Hunter has its premiere. On this occasion you can buy a game with a [b]20% discount until October 4th![/b]
